name: Keyboard Hook
goalName: Create an event to capture key combinations while the window has no focus
goal: While playing the game, it requires a lot of extra steps to tab out, press a button or key, and tab back into the game. Instead, it is most effective to press a key (combination) without having to focus the application.

approach.text: The following source gave me a base idea of how I could implement a keyboard hook: <<source Menol. (2019, January 10). Set global hotkeys using C#. Stack Overflow. Retrieved April 22, 2023, from https://stackoverflow.com/questions/2450373/set-global-hotkeys-using-c-sharp>>.
Having the code to create the shortkey, I made a small UI and added the necessary code to apply the shortkeys to the UI.
I tested the application, which worked as intended.

result: The following video shows the result, where I put the focus on Notepad but am able to increment the counters without having to tab out. Finally, I added a reset shortcut to set all the states back to 0.<<video https://www.youtube.com/embed/v8E1iMT2dGc>>
validation: Over the years, I used this program a lot. It is quick, lightweight, and incredibly helpful in the game.
contribution: This tool helps with tracking hook states in the game so the player does not actively remember who they have hooked and how many times.
